title: Fracture Evaluated in Emergency Room by Ultra Sound
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare fracture diagnostic, conventional x-ray versus ultrasound.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Recent trauma to the wrist, ankle or fingers
* clinical exam by ER staff and x-ray indication.
* informed concent

Exclusion Criteria:

* open fracture
* wounds
* unstable fractures requiring cast immobilisation before x-ray
* multi traumatised patients
